observations.fact: _offline_deadline_projection explicitly reports OFFLINE_SIGNAL_ONLY, risk_projection_available=False, no_sdk_read_only_risk_projection and empty risk_actions.
observations.implication: New read-only execution timing slice must preserve existing signal-only label where authoritative risk facts are missing.

observations.fact: After one intent is consumed, _deadline_projection anchors 1s/3s/60s to max cohort receive_monotonic_ns; intent execution_status is NOT_SUBMITTED_REPLAY.
observations.implication: This is intentionally a signal diagnostic, not actual SDK intent/native-send/first-exposure timing. Future runtime timing needs distinct proved origins and cannot relabel this anchor.

observations.fact: notify_idle(now=None) rejects missing trusted now; accepted explicit now only revalidates existing cohort and does not project actual order/holding risk.
observations.implication: A future actual no-argument Cerebro idle consumer needs an explicit bound provider with source/scope/domain; never reuse last tick receive time as current now.

observations.fact: run_replay builds channel Cerebro+TickBroker and optional invoke_idle_probe invokes strategy.notify_idle after cerebro.run.
observations.implication: Direct optional post-run probe does not establish no-tick active-engine 50ms cadence. New functional fixture must exercise actual engine dispatch and label performance proof separately.

observations.fact: execution currently configures limit order type and request/day attempt caps, without explicit scoped runtime clock/execution-fact-provider contract.
observations.implication: Timing configuration/source schema requires a bounded reviewed addition; no actual SDK risk-grant source is established by config fields.

observations.fact: notify_tick is the only normal intent producer; next/notify_bar increment compatibility counts, and idle does not create ordinary intents.
observations.implication: Preserve accepted FQ1/cohort behavior while adding risk and ordinary-position-exit consumers; do not introduce bar-driven high-frequency entries.
